format: Graphdeco 3D Gaussian Splat PLY for SuperSplat
source_relation: Same dataset, sweep, configuration and seed as the 2D comparison figure, but from a later checkpoint regeneration run; not the exact original training run.
covariance: L lower triangular: diag=raw_diag^2+1e-4, offdiag=raw_offdiag; covariance=(L L^T)^-1; eigendecomposition yields scales and wxyz quaternion
caveat: SuperSplat uses standard alpha compositing, unlike the native UltraGauss weighted-average renderer.
